title: Oil gains over 1% as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz Strait
summary: President Trump publicly rejected Iran's conditional seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, saying Iran is 'losing so badly.' Brent crude surged ~1.9% to about $106.30/bbl; WTI rose ~1.3% to ~$93.62/bbl in early Asia trading Monday. US equity futures fell: Dow futures -160+ points, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures each -~0.3%.
why: 油价急升对港股能源板块构成情绪支撑，但令美股整体承压（高通胀预期+利率上移）；对持仓中依赖原材料/能源的消费与制造标的有成本端压力；sell put 策略需警惕波动率扩大风险。

title: Stock Market Today (Sept 28): US Futures Slip Amid Oil Surge and Elevated Treasury Yields
summary: US equity-index futures slipped ~0.3% in early Asian trading as Middle East tensions reignited on Trump's rejection of Iran's Hormuz deal. US 10-year Treasury yields remain near cycle highs following the Fed's September rate hike to 3.75%–4%, weighing on growth stocks and broad risk sentiment.
why: 美债收益率高企压制成长股估值（英伟达、谷歌、特斯拉等持仓），同时HK市场需关注整体风险偏好下行；当日重大头条主要集中于伊朗冲突与宏观层面，当日个股重大头条偏少。Bloomberg为硬墙媒体，已提供CNBC交叉引用。

title: Hawkish Wind Sweeps the Fed: Three Officials Warn of Inflation Risks on the Same Day
summary: Three Federal Reserve officials issued hawkish warnings about inflation risks on the same day, reinforcing the higher-for-longer rate environment. The coordinated hawkish tone is consistent with US 10-year Treasury yields sitting near cycle highs and the Fed's September hike to the 3.75%–4% target range.
why: 联储官员集体偏鹰信号强化高利率预期，对持仓成长股（英伟达、谷歌等）估值构成压制；与当前国债收益率高位格局相互印证。注：富途域名被代理封禁，正文无法读取，内容仅基于搜索摘要标题，verified=false。

title: HK Market Weekly Preview: Four New Listings Debut Tuesday, HKEX Closed Thursday for National Day
summary: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange will be closed on Thursday October 1 for National Day, leaving only three trading days this week (Monday Sept 29 – Wednesday Oct 1 eve). Four new shares debut on Tuesday Sept 29: Benmo Technology (06731.HK), Jingwang Electronics (03228.HK), Tongcheng New Materials (09607.HK), and Robotech (03757.HK). The compressed trading week combined with multiple IPO floats may affect market liquidity and sentiment.
